name: drawio-blocks
description: Edit and render draw.io diagrams inside Markdown code blocks, online or with an optional local editor.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/verify-build.mjs && node scripts/verify-frame-policy.mjs && node scripts/verify-preview-timeout.mjs && node scripts/verify-ui.mjs && node scripts/verify-offline-runtime.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
